taxonomy.label: Refugees & Forced Displacement
taxonomy.scope: Retain distinctions between refugees, asylum seekers and internally displaced people. Migration alone does not establish forced displacement.

taxonomy.label: Homelessness & Housing Insecurity
taxonomy.scope: Housing circumstances need explicit support. Poverty or residence in a domestic-violence shelter alone does not establish homelessness.

taxonomy.label: Defence, Veterans & Security Services
taxonomy.scope: Identify the service group in each source. Military service does not automatically establish combat or war exposure.

taxonomy.label: Indigenous Peoples & Communities
taxonomy.scope: Retain the specific peoples, country and context identified in the source. These terms are search routes, not interchangeable identities.

taxonomy.label: Domestic & Family Violence
taxonomy.scope: Anxiety, PTSD, depression, abuse or trauma alone does not establish domestic or family violence. Effects on symptoms remain distinct from effects on violence.

taxonomy.label: War & Conflict-Related Trauma
taxonomy.scope: Require an explicit war or armed-conflict context. Natural disasters, generic trauma and veteran status alone do not establish this category.
